step1_analysis.circuit_type: PMOS Current Mirror (Sub-block of Variable Gain Amplifier)
step1_analysis.description: A basic PMOS current mirror that duplicates a reference current. It is likely part of the temperature-compensated bias network for the variable gain amplifier described in the paper.

paper_reference.title: A Variable Gain Amplifier With 50-dB Control Range for 900-MHz Applications

current_gain_db.description: Current mirroring ratio in dB (Iout/Iref). Maps to the paper's Gain metric, though for a 1:1 mirror it should be 0 dB.

sky130_expected.reasoning: 1:1 mirror ratio based on identical W and L for XM1 and XM2.

bandwidth.description: Frequency at which the current gain drops by 3 dB. Maps to the paper's operating frequency metrics.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by parasitic capacitances at node N3 and VR.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A simple current mirror in 130nm should easily achieve >1GHz bandwidth.

power_dissipation.description: Total DC power consumption. Maps to the paper's output power / power consumption.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a 10uA reference current and 1.8V supply.

output_resistance.description: Small-signal output resistance of the current mirror.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard output resistance for a single-transistor current source.

compliance_voltage.description: Maximum output voltage before the mirror transistor enters the triode region and current drops by 10%.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law model for PMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for PMOS current mirror measuring current gain, bandwidth, output resistance, compliance voltage, and power dissipation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PMOS Current Mirror Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VR N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Iref N3 0 dc 10u ac 1
Vout VR 0 dc 0.9 ac 0

.control
* 1. Operating Point (Current Gain and Power)
op
let i_out = i(Vout)
let i_ref = 10u
let current_gain_linear = i_out / i_ref
let current_gain_db = 20 * log10(current_gain_linear)
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print current_gain_linear current_gain_db power

* 2. AC Analysis 1: Bandwidth
ac dec 10 1 100G
let i_out_ac = mag(i(Vout))
let current_gain_ac_db = 20 * log10(i_out_ac)
meas ac dc_gain find current_gain_ac_db at=10
let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac bandwidth when current_gain_ac_db=gain_3db fall=1

* 3. AC Analysis 2: Output Resistance
alter Iref ac = 0
alter Vout ac = 1
ac dec 10 1 100G
let rout = 1 / mag(i(Vout))
meas ac rout_dc find rout at=10

* 4. DC Sweep: Compliance Voltage
dc Vout 0 1.8 0.01
* Find the voltage where output current drops to 9uA (10% drop from 10uA nominal)
meas dc compliance_voltage when i(Vout)=9u fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
